name: The Dreamweaver
source:
"I am the Dreamweaver. It is my occupation, my title and my name."

"It is my very existence."

"A child's footsteps echo through the vast hallways of dreams."

Curious and playful, as only a child can be, the little girl ventures into a vast chamber, where she meets a man of smoke and stardust.

[From [url=https://rumrat.itch.io/the-dreamweaver]itch.io[/url]]
